description:
A fabulous three bedroomed home in the popular village of Houghton, overlooking the Green and within a stones throw of local shops and post office. The property is set in a quiet location with excellent access to local transport links. Entrance hall with nook, leading to the first reception room with bay window and decorative fireplace and inset gas fire. To the rear of the property is an attractive open plan kitchen/diner with cosy log burning stove and French doors leading out to an extensive rear garden. Modern kitchen with a great range of wall and base units and integrated electric oven, gas hob and extractor fan. To the first floor are two double bedrooms and one single bedroom and a three piece bathroom with shower over bath. Front garden with driveway parking for two vehicles and gated side lane leading to rear paved and lawned garden with pergola. The rear garden also has a shed with electricity. An opportunity to rent a home in a sought after location, with great access to local links and within easy reach of Carlisle. This is one not to miss. Please note that this is a no smoking or vaping property.

Services Mains Water, Gas and Electricity.
